content: In tactics like rw and simp, we can use <- or ← for its arguments, to make the terms rewrite in the other direction (right to left). Both versions are accepted, but Mathlib prefers the latter. Is there an existing lint that enforces this?
linter.ppRoundtrip does detect this, but it also reports other formatting stuff as well.
Quite often, that "other formatting stuff" is also desirable :)
Otherwise: no, this seems like a style linter that's still missing.
Hmm, then is there a way to format files by the pretty print result? I searched around and it seems there isn't an official formatter for lean as of yet.
It would be useful as a CI action.
You will have to wait for an official formatter but it is being worked on
I see, then I'll looking forward to its release. Thanks!
btw #mathlib4 > Arrow style got a bunch of upvotes
I wonder if people would also agree to prefer ↦ over =>
This was already discussed, consensus was not reached
The only good opinion is clearly ↦ in things that are morally "math" and => in things that are morally "code". https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_mean_(philosophy) :sunglasses:
